text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After winning the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen, Air Shakur 
became the darling of an era. But as for 
Shakur himself—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—All the target races are over. Which 
means I've gotta recalculate where we go 
from here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And so, I'm gonna "disappear" for a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I also wanna upgrade 'Parcae' even 
further, so this is when I need to 
concentrate more than ever. Like hell I've 
got time for academy stuff."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't come asking you to cover it up. 
...I told you I'd share the bare minimum, 
after all."
choice_data_list: Did you tell everyone else too?
Did you tell everyone else too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's "everyone"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, that's how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are things only she can understand 
and accomplish. I trusted her and saw her 
off—and indeed, I wasn't able to contact 
her for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come now, bring out Shakur-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I know you're hiding her in your fortress! 
I need a sample of her tone to create a 
new opera. Quickly! Come on, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu~~... Shakur-saaan...! Please come 
backkk~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You must already hate me by now, right...? 
I know I have... nothing but bad traits, 
but I'll fix every single one of them, I 
swear~...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you don't keep me company in 
conversation, Shakur, organizing my 
thoughts becomes dreadfully sluggish. Cafe 
won't give me the time of day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really understand advanced 
topics. Besides... dealing with 
Tachyon-san is best split halfway with 
Shakur-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur-chan, how are you doing? I hadn't 
seen you lately, so I got worried! As long 
as you're doing okay, though..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAUUUUUGH! Shakale-saaaan~~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone rushed over out of 
concern after suddenly losing contact with 
Air Shakur.
choice_data_list:
(I wonder what kind of face Shakaar would 
make if she saw this)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, what should I do...? What if I can't 
ever come back like this...?!"
It's okay, they should be back soon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right, Shakur's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, hey, aren't we almost...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It means there's no way Shakur could ever 
stay away from 'that place' for long!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, making everyone worry this much 
shows you just "don't get it" at all. 
Naughty girls like that—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I want to teach them a lesson.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me? I have a proposal for 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(My thoughts are sharpening and clearing 
up. This feeling of diving into a world of 
zeros and ones... The absolute comfort of 
everything being lucid and aligned.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(However... what is this? I'm craving 
something terribly... My mind is 
satisfied, yet my body is starving. I want 
to proceed with my plans as is. But—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I wanna run so bad—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —I've been waiting for you, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You... And Fine, too...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why am I... Is this the academy? 
Since when... huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You were completely lost in the moment, 
weren't you? You've been wanting to run 
for a while now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because... that "obsession with victory" 
is what drives you forward.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is ready to run with you. 
Dotou-chan, Opera O-chan, Top Road-san, 
Digital-chan..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Besides, me too! But, I have one 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Conditions...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: To reflect on my mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so worried about you. You'd 
better reflect on what you did, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whatever I'm doing, it's none of your 
business.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It does matter. And you share 
responsibility too. After all, the 
relationship has already begun.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...I never asked for that—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whether you want it or not. You need to 
realize that you are responsible for your 
own existence, and that you reside in the 
hearts of others.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Someone who runs like that can't just 
walk away so easily.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To continually feel the weight of my own 
existence. That is the condition I desire.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just how much do you love my running, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The one who made me this way... was you, 
wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So, did you get an answer?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "...I AM SORRY FOR NOT CONTACTING YOU."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Very good.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll go on ahead. Once you've cleaned 
everything up, meet me at the track!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Let's go get that ramen we promised 
too, okay? The limited-time special is 
ending soon!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... Dammit. The plan is... ...Guess 
I'll have to finalize the rest back at the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...What Fine said about 'feeling the 
weight'... I don't get it at all."
choice_data_list: Looks like they put a collar on you.

Looks like you got a collar put on you, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey. I'm not a dog or a cat, y'know.
choice_data_list: Still, what about from now on?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tell anyone who might get noisy about 
it. Tell 'em I'm... just taking it easy.
